create.name: Kristel Kernaghan
create.bio:
Kristel Kernaghan is an evidential medium and teacher of intuitive and mediumship development in Winnipeg. She says she sensed the spirit world from childhood, in a family with a history of intuitive gifts, and the death of her brother Sean deepened her sense of what the work was for. After some years of reading part time she made it her full-time work around 2010. Her training includes advanced mediumship study at Arthur Findlay College in England, Reiki to master-teacher level and shamanic practice with the Foundation for Shamanic Studies, and she is ordained as an interfaith minister.

In 2007 she and her husband, the hypnotherapist Darcy Kernaghan, founded Divine Clarity, a spiritual centre and crystal shop on Portage Avenue that moved into its current, larger home in 2016. Through its academy she teaches roughly fifty classes and events a year, from mediumship and intuition development to Akashic reading and energy work, with students joining in the studio or live on Zoom. She also gives private, group and gallery readings, in person and by video. Her teaching is practical and down to earth, centred on the idea that love and connection carry on after death.

Kristel Kernaghan on North Dakota Today discussing Mediumship for a Gallery Medium Reading Event.

courses.title: Evidential Mediumship & The Afterlife (Mediumship Level 2)
courses.description: A two-day practice-heavy workshop for developing mediums who already know the basics, on giving specific evidence, holding a link with spirit for longer and working with several communicators. Taught in the Winnipeg studio with the option to join live online.

courses.title: Successful Lightworker & Mentorship
courses.description: A weekend of professional training, run once a year, for people who give or plan to give readings or energy sessions. She draws on nearly two decades of full-time practice to cover alignment, confidence and building a sustainable spiritual practice.

courses.title: Forever Connected
courses.description: A one-day workshop, open to anyone, on what she has come to understand about the soul's journey after death and the signs, dreams and feelings through which loved ones may make contact. It includes a guided meditation for connecting with spirit; attend in person or on Zoom.

courses.title: Akashic Soul Reader Certification
courses.description: A three-day certification in reading the Akashic Records for others, covering the soul's journey, working with guides and light beings, and how to frame a reading for a client. Aimed mainly at people who already give intuitive or medium readings.

courses.title: Medium Readings with Kristel Kernaghan
courses.description: Private, small-group and gallery readings in which she relays messages from people who have died. Sessions take place at the Winnipeg centre or by video; private bookings currently run more than a year ahead.
